rules: Task membership, state, conditions, K and gate are frozen before candidate outcomes are generated.
These tasks and state were not used to fit the D21 candidate utility ranker.
The frozen D18 attribution model, D16 parser, hard gate and D21 utility model cannot be changed from these outcomes.
Every scenario is retained, including candidate pools with zero or eight successes.
Oracle is a post-outcome ceiling only and is never deployable.
This confirmation pool cannot be used for training, threshold selection, feature design or calibration of this frozen version.
